sub_indicators.label: Rural internet gap
sub_indicators.subject: include.divides
sub_indicators.text: Bridging of digital divides: rural internet gap
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Digital Transformation Strategy asks for universal, equitable and affordable access for all people wherever they live; the ITU's 2030 targets ask for universal internet use.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no programme brings internet access to rural areas.
In the past three years the government or its universal service fund has launched, funded or prepared a programme to bring internet access to rural or underserved areas.
In the past three years a rural connectivity programme has connected a stated number of rural sites, towers, localities or people.
The programme is delivering, and the share of people using the internet in rural and in urban areas is published from the past three years, by a household survey or the statistics office.
The gap is measured, and rural internet use is 80 per cent or more of the urban rate, from a household survey of the past three years.
